instruction: I accidentally turned off Safe Browsing in Chrome and now I'm worried about security. Can you help me turn it back on?

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"safebrowsing":{"enabled": false}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to enable Safe Browsing feature in Chrome security settings. The evaluator checks that safebrowsing.enabled is set to true. Verified by analyzing Chrome preferences safebrowsing settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: Safe Browsing enabled in Chrome
Getter logic is correct: reads Chrome Preferences file and checks both safebrowsing.enabled and safebrowsing.enhanced fields
Metric comparison is correct: compares boolean result against expected boolean value (true)
Expected value is semantically correct: expects true for enabled Safe Browsing
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (enable Safe Browsing) and evaluator verifies it
State accessibility is correct: getter reads persisted Chrome preferences file, not UI-dependent state
Cross-platform support: handles Windows, macOS, and Linux paths correctly
Logical OR handling: correctly treats either standard or enhanced mode as 'enabled'
No postconfig needed: static validation warning is false positive - Safe Browsing settings are persisted in preferences file and don't require UI inspection
